messages:
maria_cs: Heads-up — Aurora Bridge requested a temporary QPS bump in jp region (ap-northeast-1) and IP allowlist additions for their pilot starting Mon. They want 50 -> 200 qps for 72h and auto-revoke after the window. Can infra/peering confirm egress capacity and routing? :eyes:

tim_devex: noted. Do we have the exact CIDRs and an explicit revoke timestamp? Also want this scoped to jp-edge-1 only, right?

maria_cs: Correct scope = jp-edge-1. CIDRs listed in the support ticket: 203.0.113.10/32, 203.0.113.11/32, 198.51.100.0/24. They asked for expiry after 72h; proposed revoke 2026-04-09T00:00:00Z.

sam_infra: I can apply a temporary policy and tag it cs-aurora-2955554321. Need nina to confirm peering/egress slot and whether any manual BGP provisioning required.

nina_prodops: Capacity check: we have headroom for 200 qps for a 72h window in jp-edge-1. Peering: one egress slot free but we need to add the route to the peering table (manual via infra runbook). I'll paste the minimal policy snippet — infra can apply.

ops_bot: policies.validate — quick check passed for policy name uniqueness and region scope.

sam_infra: policy snippet I'm going to apply (will paste change id after apply):

```# temp policy
route: ap-northeast-1
region_scope: jp-edge-1
policy_name: cs-aurora-2955554321
qps: 200
auto_revoke: 2026-04-09T00:00:00Z
allowlist:
  - 203.0.113.10/32
  - 203.0.113.11/32
  - 198.51.100.0/24
notes: temporary pilot window, auto-revoke enabled
```

sam_infra: applying now via internal CLI: `redwoodctl config apply --file /tmp/cs-aurora-2955554321.yaml`

ops_bot: change accepted, id change_9071, queued at 2955554328.

tim_devex: quick ask — can someone add a short blurb to the onboarding doc and the postmortem template about temporary regional bumps? helps future CS handoffs.

maria_cs: will do. I'll email Aurora Bridge with the confirm + revoke time. Also flagging renewal risk: if they keep this level we should review pricing / commit options after the pilot.

sam_infra: change_9071 applied; routes updated and egress slot bound to policy. Monitoring alarms created for sustained >180 qps.

nina_prodops: loop closure: peering bgp routes pushed, auto-revoke job scheduled for 2026-04-09T00:00:00Z. If CS requests extension, we need a ticket 24h before revoke.

maria_cs: perfect — thanks all. I'll close the support ticket after customer ack. :thumbsup:
